keyword.en: how to order from the Xingtai factory photograph
keyword.zh: 看到邢台工厂照片后如何下单

title.en: The Xingtai Factory Photograph Still Needs a Model Path
title.zh: 邢台工厂照片仍然要配上型号路径

description.en: The Xingtai factory photograph shows Renze Industrial Park. It does not name a model or a price. Choose a product path, then confirm the price with Xingtai.
description.zh: 邢台工厂照片显示的是任泽工业园区。它不写型号，也不写价格。先选定产品路径，再向邢台询盘确认价格。

h1.en: Name a Product Path After You See the Factory
h1.zh: 看到工厂之后，写上产品路径

directAnswer.en: The large factory photograph on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery site shows the Xingtai works. The published address is Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai City, Hebei Province, China, in the Xingjiawan concrete machinery manufacturing area. That photograph does not name a model, a kilowatt figure or a price. An order still picks a path such as /products/electric-concrete-pumps, /products/diesel-concrete-pumps, /products/mixer-pumps or /products/spraying-machines, then the model page. Send mix or material, maximum aggregate, required output, horizontal and vertical distance, diesel or site voltage and frequency, country and purchase timing. Confirm the price with Xingtai at /contact. A model note in this set is /blog/buy-rural-diesel-concrete-pump-unused-photo-inquiry.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械网站上的大幅工厂照片拍的是邢台工厂。已公布的地址是中国河北省邢台市任泽工业园区，位于邢家湾混凝土机械制造集聚区。这张照片不写型号、不写千瓦，也不写价格。订单仍要先选定路径，例如 /products/electric-concrete-pumps、/products/diesel-concrete-pumps、/products/mixer-pumps 或 /products/spraying-machines，再进入型号页。请发送材料或配合比、最大骨料、目标输送量、水平与垂直距离、柴油或现场电压和频率、国家与采购时间。价格向邢台询盘确认，用 /contact。本批的型号说明见 /blog/buy-rural-diesel-concrete-pump-unused-photo-inquiry。

heading.zh: 这张照片标明的是什么

body.en: It identifies Hebei Pinjin Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. at Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai. The postal code published with that address is 055150. It does not identify one pump.
body.zh: 它标明的是河北品锦机械制造有限公司，位于邢台任泽工业园区。与该地址一起公布的邮编是 055150。它不指向某一台泵。

body.en: Open /products/electric-concrete-pumps, /products/diesel-concrete-pumps, /products/mixer-pumps or /products/spraying-machines, then the model page whose printed cells match the job. Put that model path in the inquiry.
body.zh: 打开 /products/electric-concrete-pumps、/products/diesel-concrete-pumps、/products/mixer-pumps 或 /products/spraying-machines，再进入与工况相符的型号页。把该型号路径写进询盘。

body.en: Confirm the price with Xingtai. Do not read a price, a lead time or a certificate off the photograph. Listed machines ship from Xingtai. Write to /contact. See /blog/buy-rural-diesel-concrete-pump-unused-photo-inquiry.
body.zh: 价格向邢台询盘确认。不要从照片上读价格、交期或证书。所列机器从邢台发货。写信到 /contact。参见 /blog/buy-rural-diesel-concrete-pump-unused-photo-inquiry。

question.en: Does the factory photo include a price?

answer.en: No. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 没有。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Where do I send the inquiry?

answer.en: Use /contact, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. The factory is in Xingtai.
answer.zh: 使用 /contact、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。工厂在邢台。

question.en: Can I order “the machine in the photo”?
question.zh: 可以按“照片里的机器”下单吗？

answer.en: Add a product path. The photograph alone does not select a catalogue row.
answer.zh: 要加上产品路径。只有照片，选不中目录里的某一行。

question.en: Is there an overseas warehouse on this page?

answer.en: The site does not claim an overseas warehouse. Shipment is from Xingtai.
answer.zh: 本站不声称有海外仓。从邢台发货。
